mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aup_record ( template_id, template_version, version, register_no, register_year, register_seq, current_stage, round_no, draft_source, review_form, origin_register_no, carried_over_count, expire_at, project_name, pi_user_id, pi_name, dept, project_source, project_group_name, submitted_at, approved_at, created_by, is_demo, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{templateId}, #{templateVersion}, #{version}, #{registerNo}, #{registerYear}, #{registerSeq}, #{currentStage}, #{roundNo}, #{draftSource}, #{reviewForm}, #{originRegisterNo}, #{carriedOverCount}, #{expireAt}, #{projectName}, #{piUserId}, #{piName}, #{dept}, #{projectSource}, #{projectGroupName}, #{submittedAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{isDemo}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM aup_record WHERE register_no = #{registerNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM aup_record WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE aup_record SET current_stage = #{toStage}, version = version + 1, draft_source = COALESCE(#{draftSource}, draft_source), round_no = COALESCE(#{roundNo}, round_no), register_no = COALESCE(#{registerNo}, register_no), register_year = COALESCE(#{registerYear}, register_year), register_seq = COALESCE(#{registerSeq}, register_seq), expire_at = COALESCE(#{expireAt}, expire_at), approved_at = COALESCE(#{approvedAt}, approved_at), submitted_at = COALESCE(#{submittedAt}, submitted_at), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND current_stage = #{fromStage} AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE aup_record SET project_name = COALESCE(#{projectName}, project_name), pi_user_id = COALESCE(#{piUserId}, pi_user_id), pi_name = COALESCE(#{piName}, pi_name), dept = COALESCE(#{dept}, dept), project_source = COALESCE(#{projectSource}, project_source), project_group_id = COALESCE(#{projectGroupId}, project_group_id), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE aup_record SET animal_allowlist = #{animalAllowlist}, status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE aup_record SET animal_allowlist = NULL, status = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(register_seq), 0) FROM aup_record WHERE register_year = #{year} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM aup_record WHERE current_stage = 'approved' AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at <= #{now}

choose.when: AND (r.pi_user_id = #{scopeUserId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aup_audit_log l WHERE l.aup_id = r.id AND l.actor = #{scopeUserId}))

where.if: AND (r.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.register_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.pi_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aup_review_assignment a WHERE a.aup_id = r.id AND a.reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aup_audit_log l WHERE l.aup_id = r.id AND l.actor = #{reviewerId}))

AND (r.created_by IN (SELECT user_id FROM aro_personnel WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{submitterName}, '%')) OR r.created_by IN (SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE display_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{submitterName}, '%') OR username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{submitterName}, '%')))

mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.register_no, r.project_name, r.pi_name, r.dept, r.project_source AS project_source, r.current_stage, r.round_no, r.draft_source, r.submitted_at, r.approved_at, r.created_at, r.is_demo AS is_demo, r.created_by AS created_by, r.pi_user_id AS pi_user_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_snapshot s WHERE s.aup_id = r.id) AS snapshot_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_review_item ri WHERE ri.aup_id = r.id) AS review_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_review_item ri WHERE ri.aup_id = r.id AND ri.verdict = 'nonCompliant') AS non_compliant_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_review_assignment a WHERE a.aup_id = r.id AND a.reviewer_id = #{scopeUserId} AND a.round_no = r.round_no) AS assigned_expert_count FROM aup_record r
ORDER BY
r.submitted_at r.approved_at r.register_no r.updated_at
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_record WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_record WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND COALESCE(is_demo, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(created_by, '') NOT IN ('aro', 'demo')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM aup_record WHERE id IN #{i}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT project_group_name FROM aup_record WHERE project_group_name IS NOT NULL AND project_group_name != '' ORDER BY project_group_name
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO aup_record ( template_id, template_version, version, register_no, current_stage, round_no, draft_source, carried_over_count, project_name, pi_user_id, pi_name, project_group_name, status, approved_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
(#{r.templateId}, #{r.templateVersion}, 0, #{r.registerNo}, 'approved', 1, 'first', 0, #{r.projectName}, #{r.piUserId}, #{r.piName}, #{r.projectGroupName}, 'active', NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE project_name = VALUES(project_name), pi_user_id = VALUES(pi_user_id), pi_name = VALUES(pi_name), project_group_name = VALUES(project_group_name), status = 'active', updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id, register_no AS registerNo, project_group_name AS projectGroupName FROM aup_record WHERE current_stage = 'approved' ORDER BY id ASC
